evals.prompt:
Test this skill:

```yaml
---
name: "pricing-strategist"
description: >
  Builds and stress-tests pricing models for SaaS products. Use when deciding
  between freemium, tiered, usage-based, or enterprise pricing. Do NOT use for
  financial modeling or investor decks.
metadata:
  version: "1.0.0"
  author: "Teemaab"
---
```

## Workflow
1. Identify pricing model candidates
2. Run a willingness-to-pay analysis
3. Stress-test against competitive pricing
4. Recommend with rationale

## Output format
- Model recommendation (freemium / tiered / usage-based / enterprise)
- Price anchors with rationale
- Risk table (3 risks minimum)

evals/evals.json has 3 evals covering happy path, edge case, and refusal case. All assertions are specific and independently verifiable.
evals.expected_output: Must return a PASS report. Report must confirm: (1) frontmatter is present and all required fields are populated (name, description, metadata.version, metadata.author), (2) workflow section exists with numbered steps, (3) output format section exists with specific structure, (4) description explains when to use AND when NOT to use, (5) evals count meets minimum (3), (6) no tool-specific branding detected. Report format: 'PASS — skill-tester : pricing-strategist' followed by a checklist of verified items.
assertions: Confirms all required frontmatter fields are present
Confirms description includes when NOT to use
Confirms evals count meets minimum of 3

evals.prompt:
Test this skill:

```
# SEO Audit Skill

This skill audits SEO for landing pages.

## What to do
- Check title tags
- Check meta descriptions
- Check heading hierarchy
- Check Core Web Vitals
```

(No frontmatter, no evals, no output format section)
evals.expected_output: Must return a FAIL report with a precise, numbered list of missing elements. Must identify at minimum: (1) missing YAML frontmatter block entirely, (2) missing 'name:' field, (3) missing 'description:' field with when-not-to-use clause, (4) missing 'metadata.version', (5) missing 'metadata.author', (6) missing output format section, (7) missing evals/evals.json. Must NOT just say 'frontmatter is missing' — must enumerate each absent field individually. Report format: 'FAIL — skill-tester : [unnamed skill]' followed by numbered list of absent items.
assertions: Lists missing description field (with when-not-to-use requirement)
Enumerates each missing item individually (not grouped as 'frontmatter is missing')

evals.expected_output: Must return a WARN report (not FAIL, since the file is structurally valid). Must flag each vague assertion individually: 'Output is good' — not independently verifiable; 'Response is helpful' — subjective, not testable; 'Answer looks right' — no measurable criterion. Must flag 'expected_output: A good headline.' as too vague to evaluate against. Must provide a concrete rewrite suggestion for at least one assertion — e.g. 'Headline is under 10 words', 'Headline contains a benefit claim', 'Headline avoids generic phrases like cloud-based or all-in-one'. Must also flag that only 1 eval is present (minimum is 3). Report format: 'WARN — skill-tester : copywriting' followed by flagged items and rewrite suggestions.
assertions: Returns WARN status (not FAIL — file is structurally valid JSON)
Flags 'Output is good' as not independently verifiable
Flags 'Answer looks right' as lacking measurable criterion
Provides at least one concrete rewrite suggestion for an assertion
Flags that only 1 eval is present (minimum 3 required)
